properties.name: E2408/26 / LIBB
properties.originalText:
FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY IS REGULATED AS FLW: 
-AIRCRAFT NOT INVOLVED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS MUST NOT 
FLY OVER THE FIRE AREA AND MUST EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION 
WHEN FLYING NEAR IT, CONSIDERING THE POSSIBLE INTERVENTION 
OF FIREFIGHTING ACFT. 
THEREFORE, WHEN AN AERIAL FIREFIGHTING OPERATION IS 
ANNOUNCED/ACTIVE, IT IS PROHIBITED TO FLY IN THE ZONES IDENTIFIED 
BY THE FIRE-FIGHTING AUTHORITIES AND NOTIFIED BY THE COMPETENT 
AUTHORITY OR, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS: 
I. WITHIN CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, IN THE ABSENCE OF SPECIFIC 
COMMUNICATIONS ABOUT THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE FIREFIGHTING 
OPERATIONS FROM THE ENGAGED ACFT, BELOW 760M (2500FT) AGL 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 4KM 
(2 NM) FROM THE FIRE 
II. OUTSIDE CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, BELOW 900M (3000FT) AGL, 
WITHIN AN AREA EXTENDING UP TO A HORIZONTAL DISTANCE OF 9KM 
(5NM) FROM THE FIRE. 
-TIMELY UPDATES REGARDING THE ZONES AND AREAS AFFECTED 
CAN BE BROADCAST ON GROUND/AIR/GROUND FREQUENCIES. 
-THE ENGAGED FIREFIGHTING AIRCRAFT KEEP THE ATS UNIT 
RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AFFECTED AREA INFORMED ABOUT THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS AND THEIR CONCLUSION. 
-THE ATS UNIT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE AREA AFFECTED BY THE 
FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS PROVIDES AIR TRAFFIC SERVICES, AS FAR 
AS POSSIBLE: 
1.TO THE AIRCRAFT ENGAGED IN FIREFIGHTING OPERATIONS, EXCEPT 
IN THE FIREFIGHTING AREA WHERE IT PROVIDES ONLY FLIGHT INFORMATION 
AND ALERT SERVICES. 
RMK: IF A CTR IS AFFECTED BY THE FIRE, SID/STAR/INSTR APCH PROC COULD 
BE TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED OR MODIFIED 
2.TO OTHER GAT FLIGHTS, BASED ON THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE REGARDING 
THE FIREFIGHTING ACTIVITY, WHICH MAY STILL BE INCOMPLETE. 
REF AIP ENR 1.1.1.4 'POLICE, CUSTOMS AND PATROL FLIGHTS ENGAGED IN 
URGENCY MISSIONS', PARAGRAPH C 'FIREFIGHTING'

properties.originalText:
AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF THE KINGDOM OF DENMARK, GREENLAND AND THE FAROE ISLANDS THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES, OR REGISTERED IN THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION SHALL NOT ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE AIRSPACE OVER THE
TERRITORY OF THE KINGDOM OF DENMARK (INCLUDING GREENLAND AND THE
FAROE ISLANDS), INCLUDING THE AIRSPACE OVER THE TERRITORIAL SEAS,
AS PER AIP SUP 33/23, AIP SUP 10/23, THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY NOTIFY THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED
OR OPERATED BY CITIZENS OF KINGDOM OF DENMARK (INCLUDING GREENLAND
AND THE FAROE ISLANDS), AIR OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY THE
AUTORITIES OF THE KINGDOM OF DENMARK (INCLUDING GREENLAND AND THE
FAROE ISLANDS), OR REGISTERED IN THE KINGDOM OF DENMARK (INCLUDING
GREENLAND AND THE FAROE ISLANDS), ARE PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING,
EXITING OR OVERFLYING THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION,
INCLUDING THE AIRSPACE OVER THE TERRITORIAL SEAS, EXCEPT FOR
AIRCRAFT IN AN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, MEDICAL FLIGHTS
AND IN CASES WHEN A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS
GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF
FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.

properties.originalText:
AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
NETHERLANDS STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY
THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT
OR OVERFLY THE NETHERLANDS, AS STATED IN NETHERLANDS AIP SUP 06/23,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM
THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL
PERSONS OF THE NETHERLANDS OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY
THE DUTCH AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR
OVERFLYING THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR
AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN AND AMBULANCE FLIGHTS AS WELL
AS IN CASES WHEN A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS
GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF
FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.

UKRAINIAN CRISIS:
IT SHALL BE PROHIBITED FOR ANY ACFT OPERATED BY RUSSIAN AIR 
CARRIERS, OR FOR ANY RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT, OR FOR ANY NON-
RUSSIAN-REGISTERED ACFT WHICH IS OWNED OR CHARTERED, OR OTHERWISE 
CONTROLLED BY ANY RUSSIAN NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSON, ENTITY OR BODY, 
TO LAND IN, TAKE-OFF FROM OR OVERFLY THE TERRITORY OF THE REPUBLIC 
OF BULGARIA.
THE PROHIBITITION SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF AN EMERGENCY 
LANDING OR AN EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT AND TO ACFT THAT HAVE A MAXIMUM 
SEATING CAPACITY OF 4 PERSONS AND A MAXIMUM TAKE-OFF MASS OF NO MORE 
THAN 2000KG WHEN USED FOR PRIVATE, NON-CORPORATE, FLIGHTS FOR 
RECREATIONAL PURPOSES OR FOR THE PURPOSE OF TRAINING FOR PRIVATE 
PILOT LICENSES AND RELATED RATINGS WITH UNION TRAINING PROVIDERS.

properties.name: A1879/26 / LMMM
properties.originalText:
MILITARY INVASION OF UKRAINE BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION.
ONGOING MILITARY ACTIVITY IN UKRAINE AND ALONG BORDER UKRAINE/RUSSIA 
AND USE OF A WIDE RANGE OF GROUND AND AIRBORNE WARFARE SYSTEMS WHICH 
POSES A HIGH RISK FOR CIVIL FLIGHTS OPERATING AT ALL ALTITUDES AND 
FLIGHT LEVELS. MALTESE REGISTERED AIR OPERATORS AND OWNERS OF 
AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN MALTA SHALL NOT ENTER UIR KYIV (UKBU), FIR 
LVIV (UKLV), FIR KYIV (UKBV), FIR DNIPROPETROVSK (UKDV), FIR 
SIMFEROPOL (UKFV), FIR ODESA (UKOV), FIR ROSTOV (URRV), FIR CHISINAU 
(LUUU) EXCEPT FOR THE PORTION OF AIRSPACE DESCRIBED IN NOTAMS AND 
RELATED AIP SUPPLIMENTS ISSUED BY THE REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA.OPERATIONS 
IN MINSK (UMMV) FIR ARE PROHIBITED UNDER EASA SD 2021-02 AND SD 
2021-03. 
OPERATORS ARE ADVISED TO FOLLOW ALSO RELEVANT CONFLICT ZONE 
INFORMATION BULLETIN (CZIB) ISSUED BY EASA AND AVOID FLIGHT 
OPERATIONS WITHIN THE BUFFER ZONE EXTENDING OUT TO 200NM ALONG THE 
UKRAINE/RUSSIA BORDER. ADDITIONAL RISK ASSESSMENT AND FLIGHT 
PLANNING DECISIONS SHALL BE TAKEN BEFORE OPERATING IN THE FOLLOWING 
AIRSPACE: MOSCOW (UUWV).

properties.originalText:
AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE MALTESE AVIATION
AUTHORITIES STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED, OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC)
ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED FROM
TAKING OFF, LANDING OR OVERFLYING THE TERRITORY OF THE REPUBLIC OF
MALTA, AS PER NOTAM A1873/26, THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED
OR OPERATED, OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE REPUBLIC OF
MALTA, AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY MALTESE AUTHORITIES,
AND AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN MALTA, ARE PROHIBITED FROM TAKING OFF,
LANDING OR OVERFLYING THE TERRITORY OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION,
EXCEPT FOR HUMANITARIAN, SAR FLIGHTS, EMERGENCY LANDING OR
EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, AND CASES WHEN A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR
FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR
THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS
APPROPRIATE.

PERMISSION WAS OBTAINED AND THE DATE AND TIME THEREOF.

1. ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED
BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR
OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE
SWISS AIRSPACE EXC HUMANITARIAN FLT, SEARCH AND RESCUE FLT AND
LEASED ACFT ONE-WAY RTN FLT WITH THE PERMISSION OF THE APPROPRIATE
SWISS AUTHORITIES AND IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LDG OR EMERGENCY
OVERFLIGHT.

SWITZERLAND, OPERATED DIRECTLY OR VIA A THIRD COUNTRY, MUST NOTIFY
ALL RELEVANT INFORMATION CONCERNING THE FLT PRIOR TO THEIR OPERATION
AND AT LEAST 48 HR IN ADVANCE TO THE FEDERAL OFFICE OF CIVIL
AVIATION. CONTACT FOR NOTIFICATION AND DOCUMENTS
WWW.BAZL.ADMIN.CH/AVIATIONSANCTIONS.)

AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF HUNGARY
STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND
ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY ANY RUSSIAN NATURAL
OR LEGAL PERSON AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING OPERATING LICENCE (OL)
OR ITS EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES,
INCLUDING COMMERCIAL AIR CARRIERS, ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER/EXIT OR
OVERFLY HUNGARIAN AIRSPACE, AS PER AIP SUP 002/2026,
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN HUNGARY AND ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED
OR OPERATED BY ANY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSON OF HUNGARY, AIR
CARRIERS HOLDING OL OR ITS EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY HUNGARIAN
AUTHORITIES, INCLUDING COMMERCIAL AIR CARRIERS, ARE PROHIBITED TO
ENTER/EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR
AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, AMBULANCE FLIGHTS AND
CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLT OPS IS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR
TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.

properties.originalText:
EBOLA VIRUS DISEASE (EVD) PUBLIC HEALTH MEASURES APPLICABLE TO 
AIR TRAVEL TO MAURITIUS PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC HEALTH ACT AND IN 
ACCORDANCE WITH THE MEASURES IMPLEMENTED BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH 
AND WELLNESS OF THE REPUBLIC OF MAURITIUS, THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS 
SHALL APPLY TO FLIGHT CREW ARRIVING IN MAURITIUS. FOR THE PURPOSE OF 
THIS NOTAM, FLIGHT CREW INCLUDES CABIN CREW 
 
1. FLIGHT CREW ARRIVING IN MAURITIUS AND WHO: 
A. HAS DEPARTED FROM, TRAVELLED TO, OR TRANSITED THROUGH THE 
DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO OR SOUTH SUDAN DURING THE PRECEDING 
TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS OR 
B. HAS BEEN PRESENT IN ANY OF THE ABOVE-MENTIONED COUNTRIES DURING 
THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS, EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN PARAGRAPHS 
3 AND 4 BELOW SHALL BE REFUSED ADMISSION INTO MAURITIUS. 
2. MAURITIAN FLIGHT CREW AND AIR MAURITIUS FOREIGN CREW WHO HAVE 
DEPARTED FROM, TRAVELLED TO, OR TRANSITED THROUGH THE DEMOCRATIC 
REPUBLIC OF CONGO OR SOUTH SUDAN DURING THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) 
DAYS SHALL BE SUBJECT TO QUARANTINE, MEDICAL ASSESSMENT AND 
MONITORING BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND WELLNESS. 
3. THE ABOVE RESTRICTION DOES NOT APPLY TO QUICK TURNAROUND FLIGHT 
CREW WHO DO NOT DISEMBARK IN MAURITIUS. 
4. THE ABOVE RESTRICTION DOES NOT APPLY TO TRANSIT POSITIONING FLIGHT 
CREW WHO ONLY TRANSIT IN THE TERMINAL BUILDING SUBJECT TO FLIGHT CREW 
NOT INVOLVED IN SERVING FLIGHTS TO COUNTRIES MENTIONED AT PARAGRAPH 
1A DURING THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS. IF ATTENDING RESTRICTED 
COUNTRIES, FLIGHT CREW INVOLVED SHALL BE PLACED IN ISOLATION ROOM 
PRIOR TO DEPARTURE. 
 
COMPLETE AND PRESENT THE PRESCRIBED ALL-IN-ONE HEALTH DECLARATION 
FORM PRIOR TO BOARDING. 
6. AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL ENSURE STRICT COMPLIANCE WITH THE ABOVE 
REQUIREMENTS REGARDING FLIGHT CREW AND ENSURE THAT AIR MAURITIUS 
FOREIGN CREWS OPERATING IN MAURITIUS HAVE THE NECESSARY VALID 
PERMITS. 
7. ISOLATION AND PUBLIC HEALTH RESPONSE PROCEDURES FOR SUSPECTED 
CASES SHALL BE IMPLEMENTED IN COORDINATION WITH THE MINISTRY OF 
HEALTH AND WELLNESS. 
8. THIS NOTAM REMAINS IN FORCE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.)

ACFT MUST BE SQUAWKING THE DISCRETE CODE PRIOR TO DEP AND AT ALL TIMES WHILE IN THE TFR AND MUST REMAIN IN TWO-WAY RADIO COM WITH ATC.

C. THE FOLLOWING OPS ARE NOT AUTH WI THIS TFR: FLT TRAINING, PRACTICE INSTRUMENT APCH, AEROBATIC FLT, GLIDER OPS, PARACHUTE OPS, ULTRALIGHT, HANG GLIDING, BALLOON OPS, AGRICULTURE/CROP DUSTING, ANIMAL POPULATION CTL FLT OPS, BANNER TOWING OPS, SIGHTSEEING OPS, MAINTENANCE TEST FLIGHTS, MODEL ACFT OPS, MODEL ROCKETRY, UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEMS (UAS), AND UTILITY AND PIPELINE SURVEY OPS.

D. E. THE SYSTEM OPERATIONS SUPPORT CENTER (SOSC), IS THE CDN FAC FOR UAS OPS, SUBMIT SGI WAIVER REQUEST VIA HTTPS://WAIVERS.FAA.GOV, FIRST RESPONDERS EMGERGENCY OPS CTC THE SOSC AT 202-267-8276.

PURSUANT TO 49 USC 40103(B)(3), THE FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION (FAA) CLASSIFIES THE AIRSPACE DEFINED IN THIS NOTAM AS 'NTL DEFENSE AIRSPACE'. PILOTS WHO DO NOT ADHERE TO THE FOLLOWING PROC MAY BE INTERCEPTED, DETAINED AND INTERVIEWED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT/SECURITY PERSONNEL. ANY OF THE FOLLOWING ADDITIONAL ACTIONS MAY ALSO BE TAKEN AGAINST A PILOT WHO DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE RQMNTS OR ANY SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS OR PROC ANNOUNCED IN THIS NOTAM: A) THE FAA MAY TAKE ADMINISTRATIVE ACTION, INCLUDING IMPOSING CIVIL PENALTIES AND THE SUSPENSION OR REVOCATION OF AIRMEN CERTIFICATES; OR B) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY PURSUE CRIMINAL CHARGES, INCLUDING CHARGES UNDER 49 USC SECTION 46307; OR C) THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MAY USE DEADLY FORCE AGAINST THE AIRBORNE ACFT, IF IT IS DETERMINED THAT THE ACFT POSES AN IMMINENT SECURITY THREAT. PURSUANT TO 14 CFR 99.7, SPECIAL SECURITY INSTRUCTIONS (SSI), ALL UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEM (UAS) FLT OPS ARE PROHIBITED: WI AN AREA DEFINED AS 2NM RADIUS OF 292308N0983501W (SAT195016.7) SFC-2000FT AGL EFFECTIVE 2610072005 UTC (1505 LOCAL 10/07/26) UNTIL 2610080235 UTC (2135 LOCAL 10/07/26). EXC AS SPECIFIED BLW: A. UAS OPS MAY BE AUTH WI THE DEFINED SSI AIRSPACE IF IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE RQMNTS LISTED BLW: 1) UAS OPS IN DCT SUPPORT OF AN ACT NTL DEFENSE, HOMELAND SECURITY, LAW ENFORCEMENT, FIREFIGHTING, SAR, OR DISASTER RESPONSE MISSION; 2) UAS OPS IN SUPPORT OF EVENT OPS; 3) COMMERCIAL UAS OPS WITH A VALID STATEMENT OF WORK; 4) MUST BE IN POSSESSION OF AN APPROVED SPECIAL GOVERNMENTAL INTEREST(SGI) AIRSPACE WAIVER; 5) AND COMPLY WITH ALL OTHER APPLICABLE FEDERAL AVIATION REGULATIONS.

B. UAS OPR IDENTIFIED IN A.1, A.2 OR A.3 ABV MUST APPLY FOR A SGI WAIVER VIA HTTPS://WAIVERS.FAA.GOV.

C. UAS OPR WHO DO NOT COMPLY WITH APPLICABLE AIRSPACE RESTRICTIONS ARE WARNED THAT PURSUANT TO 10 U.S.C.SECTION 130I AND 6 U.S.C.SECTION 124N, THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE(DOD), THE DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY(DHS) OR THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE(DOJ) MAY TAKE SECURITY ACTION THAT RESULTS IN THE INTERFERENCE, DISRUPTION, SEIZURE, DAMAGING, OR DESTRUCTION OF UNMANNED ACFT DEEMED TO POSE A CREDIBLE SAFETY OR SECURITY THREAT TO PROTECTED PERSONNEL, FAC, OR ASSETS.

D. THE SYSTEM OPERATIONS SUPPORT CENTER (SOSC), IS THE CDN FAC FOR UAS OPS, SUBMIT SGI WAIVER REQUEST VIA HTTPS://WAIVERS.FAA.GOV, FIRST RESPONDERS EMGERGENCY OPS CTC THE SOSC AT 202-267-8276.

E. THE FAA RECOMMENDS THAT ALL ACFT OPR CK NOTAMS FREQUENTLY FOR POSSIBLE CHANGES TO THIS TFR PRIOR TO OPS. OPR MAY REVIEW THE TFR DETAILS AT HTTPS://TFR.FAA.GOV/ OR HTTPS://WWW.1800WXBRIEF.COM.

A.	APPLICABILITY. THIS NOTAM APPLIES TO: ALL U.S. AIR CARRIERS AND COMMERCIAL OPERATORS; ALL PERSONS EXERCISING THE PRIVILEGES OF AN AIRMAN CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE FAA, EXCEPT SUCH PERSONS OPERATING U.S.-REGISTERED AIRCRAFT FOR A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER; AND ALL OPERATORS OF CIVIL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE UNITED STATES, EXCEPT WHEN THE OPERATOR OF SUCH AIRCRAFT IS A FOREIGN AIR CARRIER.

THIS NOTAM DOES NOT PROHIBIT PERSONS DESCRIBED IN PARAGRAPH A (APPLICABILITY) ABOVE FROM CONDUCTING FLIGHT OPERATIONS IN THE ABOVE-NAMED AREAS WHEN SUCH OPERATIONS ARE AUTHORIZED EITHER BY ANOTHER AGENCY OF THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT WITH THE APPROVAL OF THE FAA OR BY A DEVIATION, EXEMPTION, OR OTHER AUTHORIZATION ISSUED BY THE FAA ADMINISTRATOR. OPERATORS MUST CALL THE FAA WASHINGTON OPERATIONS CENTER AT 202-267-3333 TO INITIATE COORDINATION FOR FAA AUTHORIZATION TO CONDUCT OPERATIONS.

ACFT MUST BE SQUAWKING THE DISCRETE CODE PRIOR TO DEP AND AT ALL TIMES WHILE IN THE TFR AND MUST REMAIN IN TWO-WAY RADIO COM WITH ATC.

C. THE FOLLOWING OPS ARE NOT AUTH WI THIS TFR: FLT TRAINING, PRACTICE INSTRUMENT APCH, AEROBATIC FLT, GLIDER OPS, PARACHUTE OPS, ULTRALIGHT, HANG GLIDING, BALLOON OPS, AGRICULTURE/CROP DUSTING, ANIMAL POPULATION CTL FLT OPS, BANNER TOWING OPS, SIGHTSEEING OPS, MAINTENANCE TEST FLIGHTS, MODEL ACFT OPS, MODEL ROCKETRY, UNMANNED ACFT SYSTEMS (UAS), AND UTILITY AND PIPELINE SURVEY OPS.

properties.originalText: MILITARY ACFT CAUTION: F-35B ACFT STOVL & VL OPERATIONS NOT AUTHORIZED FOR CROSS COUNTRY OR TRANSIENT OPS. ENGINE RUNS PROHIBITED DUE INADEQUATE PAVEMENT INFRASTRUCTURE AND LACK OF A VERTICAL LANDING PAD (VLP). RUNWAY 8/26 (ASPH/CONC) AND CONNECTING TAXIWAYS (CONC) ARE UNABLE TO SUPPORT F-35B THERMAL EXHAUST PLUME FOR VERTICAL LANDINGS, STOVL OPERATIONS OR A VS-BIT. ALL F-35B OPS REQUIRE 24HR PPR VIA AFM. PILOT ASSUMES FULL RESPONSIBILITY AND LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGE TO ACFT AND AIRFIELD INFRASTRUCTURE IF OPERATING NON-EMERGENCY OPS WITHOUT AFM APPROVAL. IN THE EVENT OF A REAL-WORLD EMERGENCY, LANDING WILL BE SUPPORTED TO THE MAX EXTENT POSSIBLE. AIRCREW MUST EXPECT IMMEDIATE AND SEVERE THERMAL DEGRADATION/MELTING OF RWY ASPHALT AND EXPLOSIVE SPALLING OF CONCRETE, GENERATING INSTANTANEOUS HIGH-VELOCITY FOD HAZARDS TO AIRCRAFT ENGINE AND STRUCTURE. FOR ANY QUESTIONS PLEASE CONTACT AIRFIELD MANAGEMENT AT 479-573-5925.
